youtube.title: Morning Prayer for Today | Mark 1:35 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Even Jesus started his day like this.

"And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed." Mark 1:35 (KJV)

If he needed time alone with the Father before the crowds showed up, so do we.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.
